scope: source audit only; no kernel compilation or hardware validation

components.summary: Legacy mt-boot adds vendor CPU power sequencing; ACK only registers spin-table and PSCI.
components.next_test: Review legacy PSCI/MTCMOS operations against modern firmware before any owner-authorized multicore boot test.

components.summary: A modern douglas DTS exists in the community tree; ACK has no douglas/MT8163 DTS. The shared community memory declaration is 512 MiB and is not the measured 1.5 GB layout.
components.next_test: Resolve board-specific RAM/reservations/bootloader fixups; preprocess and validate the dependency closure without assuming Echo layout.

components.summary: Community MT8163 split clock drivers and bindings are available; their ACK backport is uncompiled.
components.next_test: Import and compile clock/binding changes against pinned ACK; verify resolved Kconfig and rate/parent data before runtime.

components.summary: Community MT8163 pinctrl driver and pin tables exist; board pin mux and IRQ mapping remain untested.
components.next_test: Forward/adapt pinctrl dependencies and compile; reconcile douglas pins against legacy DTS.

components.summary: ACK has MT6323 slave/regulator support; community adds MT8163 wrapper and power-domain data.
components.next_test: Port MT8163 host wrapper/domain integration and validate regulator names, interrupts and power sequencing.

components.summary: Community DT maps MT8163 MMC to the existing mt2701 fallback; actual timing/pin/regulator behavior is untested.
components.next_test: Compile controller/DT path; initially use conservative timing and validate eMMC read/write integrity only with owner authorization.

components.summary: Community has MT8163 DRM controller integration; the douglas wrapper/common DTS does not connect a panel endpoint. Legacy uses a vendor NT35521 panel driver.
components.next_test: Port/validate panel power/reset/DSI timing and controller dependencies; a simple framebuffer or controller symbol is not panel support.

components.summary: Legacy board declares goodix,gt9xx; ACK includes Goodix family driver, but chip-specific compatible/config and board wiring need adaptation.
components.next_test: Identify actual touch-controller variant/config and compare bindings/reset/IRQ/power before a tested DTS.

components.summary: ACK Panfrost recognizes T720. Kernel recognition is not an Android EGL/gralloc/composer implementation or proof of GLES compatibility.
components.next_test: Resolve Mesa T720 feature limits, DRM/SMI/IOMMU/power dependencies and Android buffer/compositor integration; run rendering tests later.

components.summary: Legacy uses the MT8163 CONSYS vendor combo stack; an upstream mt76 directory does not establish an equivalent radio driver.
components.next_test: Identify actual CONSYS radio/bus/firmware contracts and reusable drivers; resolve a bounded compile experiment before assuming wireless.

components.summary: ARM64 ACK has CONFIG_COMPAT and 4 KiB page support; Android 17 retains zygote32. Complete ARM32 userspace/app compatibility is not built.
components.next_test: Resolve a single-ABI product strategy for the 1.5 GB device, build the actual platform and test required apps; do not equate 64-bit kernel with 64-bit app ABI.

components.summary: ACK declares BPF/cgroups/Binder/SELinux support. A resolved board config and userspace policy are still required.
components.next_test: Build resolved configs, enforce SELinux, validate networking/Binder/cgroup behavior and current Android tests on hardware.
